constraint-definitions.aggregation: weighted by the held-out count of each (fold, style) cell
constraint-definitions.constraintSatisfaction: fraction of delivered rows with all three excesses <= 0 and t2n_margin >= 0, recounted from samples.csv
constraint-definitions.defectExceedanceRate: fraction of rows with at least one of the three threshold defects above its mean threshold
constraint-definitions.energyDistance: E^2 = 2E||X-Y|| - E||X-X'|| - E||Y-Y'|| on the fold-standardised chemical matrix; E_norm = sqrt(max(E^2, 0)/D_ref); D_ref = mean pairwise distance of same-style real training samples drawn at the held-out size (20 draws)
constraint-definitions.profileMetric: Spearman / MAE between the mean 50-label ridge-proxy profile of generated samples and the mean real label profile of the matching held-out rows
constraint-definitions.t2nBound: per-style q90 of the t2n sensory label in the training fold; unseen styles use the pooled q90; the transfer delivery also caps at the Tripel training q90
constraint-definitions.transferObjective: min_v ||v-v0||^2 + lambda * (Av-mu)^T Sigma^-1 (Av-mu) + eta * ||D(v)-D(src)||_1 with Q = I, 10 PCA components, Sigma = 0.9 corr + 0.1 I, box bounds for the chemistry caps and exact linear shifts for the t2n / stale_hops bounds
constraint-definitions.transferScenarios: 2 constraint policies x 2 threshold sets (mean / median), lambda=1, eta=0.01; policies: non-increasing (c_new <= c_source) and cap-at-max-source-threshold (c_new <= max(c_source, T)); nonworsenRate is policy-relative, strictNonworsenRate compares with the source value for every defect

hyperparameters.evidenceNote: the declared grid point is fixed before the held-out folds are scored and is the same for all three seeds, so the seed runs differ only through the sampled draws

selected.rule: mean of the per-fold selection scores, argmin over the 9 grid points, ties -> stronger shrinkage

proxy-notes.alphaSelection: 5-fold CV inside the training rows, per target
proxy-notes.leakage: the transfer extension fits its proxy on all 250 rows (it is a separately reported extension); the within-style main score fits the proxy on the fold's training rows only
proxy-notes.usage: the 50-label ridge map is a proxy for the t2n / stale_hops constraints and for profile reporting only; it is never a generative model of the labels

samples-provenance.floorCodeNote: X4VG is log10-calibrated and its non-detect code is the empirical repeated minimum -2.013157381 (not the global FLOOR_VALUE -1.81781854); both readings are below the 0.206 mg/L threshold, so the non-detect concentration counts as 0
samples-provenance.foldNote: fold=-1 marks style-holdout and transfer rows; slot is the matched real row id
samples-provenance.generationNote: group=generation: 3-fold out-of-fold samples, one per held-out real slot; group=style-holdout: Tripel/Kriek/Lambic from the model fitted without them; group=transfer: Pils/Lager -> Tripel delivery variant (non-worsening and threshold/t2n capped)
samples-provenance.rowNote: row is a 0-based delivered-sample id, not a real data row
samples-provenance.storageScaleNote: chem__* columns are stored exactly as in the dataset (log10 tier -> 10**x); excess__* use the mean thresholds; t2n_margin and stale_hops_margin use the ridge proxies (t2n bound = per-style/transfer cap; stale_hops bound = per-style upper decile of the proxy prediction on the fold's TRAIN rows, or the source prediction + 0.05 sd for transfer)
